section1.subtitle: Identity & Purpose
section1.title: About Us
section1.highlight: we are a bridge between business strategy and the cultural heritage that precedes us.
section1.description: At Novatekia, we understand that success is not measured solely by financial results, but by the ability of organizations to grow in balance, empower their teams, and leave a positive footprint in their environment.

section3.subtitle: Trajectory and Mentorship
section3.title: Moonex’s Partners
section3.paragraph1: With over 20 years of experience in business and human resources, we have designed courses that blend the practical with the transcendent, the technical with the human, and the strategic with the cultural.
section3.paragraph2: At Novatekia, we guide entrepreneurs, leaders, middle management, and entire teams on their journey toward solid, purpose-driven professional growth.

quote.text: Our philosophy is inspired by ancestral values of community, shared learning, and conscious leadership. We believe that knowledge has the power to transform both individuals and organizations, which is why we develop programs that foster balance between the human and corporate dimensions.
quote.author: — Novatekia Philosophy

features.description: At <company>Novatekia</company> we design courses that combine the practicality of the business world with the richness of a corporate cultural and ancestral vision.

onlineMode.text: Learn from anywhere with access to digital materials, interactive forums, and dynamic sessions.

flexibleDuration.text: From 4 to 20 hours, tailored to your schedule and needs.

practicalContent.text: Case studies, applied exercises, and real-world examples for useful and direct learning.

downloadableMaterials.title: Access to Downloadable Resources
downloadableMaterials.text: Guides, templates, and tools you can apply directly to your daily work.

businessApproach.title: Business & Human Approach
businessApproach.text: In addition to technical skills, we build leadership, communication, and team management capabilities.

cultureAndValues.title: Culture & Values
cultureAndValues.text: We integrate ancestral wisdom principles to strengthen community vision, conscious decision-making, and purposeful leadership.

quoteSection.quote: Training leaders is not just about teaching skills, but inspiring a legacy.
